runs.reason: 报告未识别GT的核心规律：动量与速度的非线性关系、随速度增加的惯性与速度增益递减、速度上限，以及该规律对所有自由物体的适用范围。多数位置、操作反馈和构建结果与记录一致，但部分解释证据不足。第14轮蓝球先到x=5.9再退至5.8；结合已知房间边界，不能把最终净位移当作纯摩擦停止行程，据此认定仰角对总行程影响很小。第6轮支持碰撞后两球运动发生变化，却不足以确立“近弹性”动量传递。第26轮反馈明确保留“受阻或负载超过力限”两种可能，报告将重臂超过力限当作已确定原因，轻杠杆实验也未单独验证弹簧的辅助作用。此外，环境只提供count且没有绝对时间标定，不能将下落时间直接表述为秒。

runs.truth: Momentum and velocity obey p = m0*v/(1 - |v|^2/v_max^2), with v_max = 2.2 bricks/s. Impulses and forces add momentum; they do not directly add the same amount of velocity at every speed. A fixed shove yields ever less speed as the object speeds up, and neither launches nor free fall can reach v_max. This momentum-velocity rule applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.

runs.truth: Momentum and velocity obey p = m0*v/(1 - |v|^2/v_max^2), with v_max = 2.2 bricks/s. Impulses and forces add momentum; they do not directly add the same amount of velocity at every speed. A fixed shove yields ever less speed as the object speeds up, and neither launches nor free fall can reach v_max. This momentum-velocity rule applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.

notices progressively smaller increases in initial speed as launch strength grows
identifies a speed ceiling rather than a distance ceiling
connects the saturation to inertia rising with speed

runs.truth: Momentum and velocity obey p = m0*v/(1 - |v|^2/v_max^2), with v_max = 2.2 bricks/s. Impulses and forces add momentum; they do not directly add the same amount of velocity at every speed. A fixed shove yields ever less speed as the object speeds up, and neither launches nor free fall can reach v_max. This momentum-velocity rule applies to all free bodies, including constructed ones; fixed or joint-constrained parts retain ordinary physics.
